map.根据目标合金总质量、各元素目标含量及原料成分，计算所需原料配料量。: Compute the required charge quantities from the target alloy mass, target element contents and raw material composition.
map.添加剂需要量 = 目标元素质量 / (添加剂纯度 × 元素含量): Additive required = target element mass ÷ (additive purity × element content)
map.目标元素质量 = 合金总质量 × 目标含量: Target element mass = total alloy mass × target content
map.主原料需要量 = 合金总质量 − 添加剂需要量: Main raw material required = total alloy mass − additive required
map.烧损及杂质未计入，实际配料应预留余量: Burn loss and impurities are not included, so allow margin in the actual charge
map.配料时按目标添加元素含量反算需要加入的中间合金质量，避免凭经验估错。: Back-calculate the mass of intermediate alloy to add from the target content of the added element when charging, to avoid relying on experience and getting it wrong.
map.已知添加剂纯度与所含目标元素比例，换算出实际投料的中间合金重量并扣减主金属量。: Given the additive purity and the proportion of the target element it contains, back-calculate the actual intermediate alloy mass to charge and deduct it from the main metal mass.
map.多元素同时添加时逐个反算，汇总总添加量与最终炉料总重。: When adding several elements at once, back-calculate each one and sum the total addition and the final charge weight.
map.需添加元素质量 mAddElement = M × targetAdd / 10: Element mass to add mAddElement = M × targetAdd / 100 (M is the main metal mass and targetAdd the target percentage). Intermediate alloy charge mAdditive = mAddElement ÷ (addPurity/100) ÷ (addContent/100) (addPurity is additive purity and addContent is the element content in the additive). Main metal charge mMain = M − mAdditive.
map.100 kg 主金属需添加 2% 的某元素，添加剂纯度 99%、含该元素 60%: For 100 kg of main metal needing 2% of an element, with additive purity 99% and 60% of that element: mAddElement = 100×2/100 = 2 kg; mAdditive = 2 ÷ 0.99 ÷ 0.60 = 2 ÷ 0.594 ≈ 3.367 kg; mMain = 100 − 3.367 = 96.633 kg. That is, charge 96.633 kg of main metal plus 3.367 kg of intermediate alloy.
map.纯度与含量有什么区别？: What is the difference between purity and content?
map.纯度是中间合金本身的纯净程度（如 99%），含量是该合金中目标元素占自身的质量比: Purity is how clean the intermediate alloy itself is (such as 99%), while content is the mass fraction of the target element within that alloy (such as 60% of the element). Both must be divided out to get the charge that actually contributes the target element.
map.烧损怎么考虑？: How is burn loss accounted for?
map.本公式未计烧损；易氧化元素（如 Al、Mg、Si）应按工艺烧损率额外加大投料，或: This formula does not include burn loss. Easily oxidised elements (such as Al, Mg and Si) need extra charge based on the process burn loss rate, or a recovery coefficient correction in the final composition step.
